title: Servicing Standard on Frozen Advances and Reinstatement — Operating Lines of Credit
content:
Advances on an active line of the Operating Lines of Credit are frozen — the line is suspended — for one of three recorded reasons: past-due interest, a borrowing base deficiency or an uncured overadvance.

## Standard

1. **Past-due interest.** Advances on an active line are frozen for past-due interest when an interest bill remains not fully paid more than the product's freeze days, in calendar days, after its due date, the due date itself being day 0. Advances are frozen for the other two reasons as set out in the overadvance policy and in the borrowing base certificate rules. The reason and the date of the freeze are recorded on the line.
2. **What a freeze stops.** Freezing stops advances only; payments, certificates and renewal requests continue to be received.
3. **Reinstatement.** A suspended line is reinstated only when the condition recorded as the reason for the freeze is cured on the record:
   - for past-due interest, every interest bill whose due date has passed is paid in full and every late charge assessed on those bills is paid or waived;
   - for a borrowing base deficiency, a certificate received after the freeze shows outstanding principal at or below its borrowing base;
   - for an uncured overadvance, outstanding principal is at or below the available credit.
   On reinstatement the recorded reason and date of the freeze are cleared.
4. **From the day booked.** Reinstatement reopens advances from the day it is booked and never back-dates advances refused while frozen.
5. **Maturity while suspended.** A line whose maturity date passes while suspended matures instead and can only be renewed or paid off.

## Freeze boundary (hypothetical bill due 15 January, 30 freeze days)

| Date | Days after the due date | Bill still not fully paid | Advances frozen for past-due interest |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 February | 30 | Yes | No — not more than 30 days |
| 15 February | 31 | Yes | Yes |

## Reinstatement judgement (hypothetical line frozen for past-due interest)

| Every past-due bill paid in full | Every late charge on those bills paid or waived | Reinstated |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
